    Material Variation Notice Due to the natural, handcrafted nature of our non-vinyl wallcoverings, variations in color, texture, and appearance may occur between digital images, samples, and final production. These characteristics are inherent to the material and should be expected.

    Antwerp

    Made almost entirely of linen, and named for a region known for the same, Antwerp fills a wall with free-flowing vertical pleats.

    Specifications

    • Composition: 97% Linen/3% Polyester
    • Backing: Non-Woven
    • Total Weight: 13 oz/lineal yd (369 gsm)
    • Width: 43" (109 cm)
    • Repeat: Non-Match
    • Full Roll: 30 YDs
    • Fire Rating: ASTM E84 - Class A
    • Seaming: Seamless
    • Environmental Impact and Sustainability: Rapidly Renewable
